items.title: quintessential
items.body: /ˌkwɪntɪˈsenʃl/ adj. 典型的；完美典范的。常作定语修饰名词，如 quintessential example/hero。例句：He is the quintessential gentleman—polite, well-read, and impeccably dressed.

items.title: juxtaposition
items.body: /ˌdʒʌkstəpəˈzɪʃn/ n. 并置，并列（尤指为了对比效果）。用于文学、艺术评论及学术写作。搭配：striking juxtaposition（鲜明的对比）。例句：The film's power lies in its juxtaposition of extreme wealth and abject poverty.

items.title: 日常寒暄：摆脱 "I'm fine"
items.body: 原句：Not too bad, can't complain. Been keeping myself busy, you know how it is. 模仿要点：注意 "not too bad" 的弱读 /nɒ tə ˈbæd/，"you know how it is" 整句语调下沉，传递松弛感。适合在电梯、茶水间等非正式场合使用，替代机械回答。

items.title: 表达犹豫：不再只说 "Maybe"
items.body: 原句：I’m kind of on the fence about it. Part of me wants to go for it, but another part is telling me to play it safe. 模仿要点："on the fence" 连读时 /nðə/ 滑音自然；"play it safe" 重音在 safe。适用于表达中立态度，比 maybe 信息量更足，语气更成熟。

items.title: 《死亡诗社》
items.body: 台词："We don't read and write poetry because it's cute. We read and write poetry because we are members of the human race." 语言点：because 从句连续出现，形成排比（parallelism）；members of the human race 是 "人类一员" 的庄重表达。适合用于议论文中关于人文价值的论证，朗读时注意在 cute 和 race 处形成情感落差。

items.title: 《星际穿越》
items.body: 台词："Do not go gentle into that good night. Rage, rage against the dying of the light." 语言点：go gentle 中 gentle 为副词用法（古雅）；rage against 是正式书面搭配。注意 dying of the light 隐喻生命/希望的消逝。朗读时前句低沉克制，后句通过重复 rage 实现爆发力，适合练习失去爆破与情感重音。
